thread:
customer_engineer: FYI — AcmeCorp (org: acme-42, region: eu-west-1, private-vpc) reporting widespread errors after HSM key rotation this morning. Some calls 401, some 500. Customer also says audit logs for the last 24h are truncated. They referenced a vendor advisory (CVE-2026-34521) and want timeline + mitigation now. Pasting sample error and tail of server logs below.

customer_engineer: ```
POST /v1/generate  -> 500
{"error":"HSM decrypt failed: CKR_GENERAL_ERROR (0x00000005)", "request_id":"req_0a1b2c3d"}
...
2026-03-17T08:12:34Z hsm: unwrap failed for key id hsm-key-77: CKR_SIGNATURE_LEN_RANGE
2026-03-17T08:12:35Z audit: write failed partially, truncated chunk id=84
```

sara.k: Got it — thanks for the context. I'm escalating. Can you confirm the earliest observed failure ts and send the affected request_ids (or one support bundle)? Also: did they rotate HSM firmware or just rotate keys? :eyes:

customer_engineer: They rotated keys via our console (no firmware action on their side). First failures ~2026-03-17T08:10Z. Sending first five request_ids in a DM.

oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-1875 — paging sec-eng and infra. Priority: high.

raj.p: I'm on it. We have a matching vendor advisory for CVE-2026-34521 that affects the key unwrapping routine on some firmware versions. Symptoms line up (mixed 401/500, partial audit writes). Immediate mitigation options: 1) fallback to a software-wrapped key (server-side) for the affected key id, 2) enable HSM call rate limiting to avoid hitting the vulnerable path repeatedly, 3) temporarily extend audit write retries. For private deployments we may need customer permission to push a firmware patch or to flip a config for local rotation.

raj.p: Quick workaround (support can perform): set fallback key for org via the private API -> this will route unwrap to our software path while we get vendor patch. Example: 
```bash
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" https://console.redwood.ai/v1/orgs/acme-42/keys/fallback -d '{"target_key_id":"hsm-key-77","reason":"cve-2026-34521 fallback"}'
```
Note: this increases CPU costs for that org and requires replay of any partially written audit chunks.

leo: Repro steps I'd like from customer: 1) a single failing request_id (you said you're DMing), 2) the last 1k lines of the node that proxied HSM calls, 3) the HSM client logs with DEBUG enabled (toggle at /admin/logs). Minimal curl to reproduce: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer USER_TOKEN" -d '{"model":"redwood-2-small","prompt":"hi"}' -i
```
If they can run that 5x and paste the request ids we can correlate.

emily: Escalated to CSM + infra lead. We're offering AcmeCorp: extended audit retention for 72h (export on S3), and a canary patch window. Tentative ETA: vendor patch expected in ~6 hours from now; our internal mitigation rollout (fallback + rate-limits) can be staged in ~4 hours to 10% of affected private customers, full rollout 24h. I'll coordinate the customer comms and SLA impact note. :lock:

sara.k: I'll coordinate the fallback action with Acme's ops. Please hold on any automated key rotations until we confirm. Also turning on extra audit-retry logic for their org now (non-disruptive).

customer_engineer: Can you confirm whether enabling fallback requires downtime? Customer worried about requests failing during the flip.

raj.p: It should be no-downtime for most traffic — we do a rolling switch per key and route new unwraps to software while existing tokens still use the HSM. There is a small window where a request hitting the vulnerable code could fail — we'll route traffic to a healthy region if possible. We'll add a short notice to CSM.

emily: Action items summary: 1) Support to collect support bundle + request_ids (leo) 2) Support to offer fallback and coordinate window with Acme (sara.k + leo) 3) Sec-eng to prepare canary and vendor patch validation (raj.p) 4) CSM to prepare comms & retention export (emily). I'll DM the customer with the mitigation plan and approximate ETA.

customer_engineer: Thanks — customer asked for an SSA or written mitigation plan they can show their security team. Can you paste a short mitigation summary they can share?

raj.p: Short mitigation summary (shareable): "We have identified a vulnerability affecting HSM key unwrapping (CVE-2026-34521) in certain firmware versions. Redwood's recommended immediate mitigations for affected private deployments: 1) route affected key IDs to our software-wrapped fallback to avoid HSM unwrapping, 2) apply vendor firmware update when available, 3) enable increased audit write retries and export the last 72h of audit logs for customer review. Our scheduled timeline: internal validation and canary rollout in ~4 hours, broader customer updates and full rollout within 24 hours. Contact: sec-eng@redwood.ai for technical questions."

sara.k: Posted mitigation summary to the customer DM and scheduled a 30m sync at 09:30 UTC to perform the fallback with them. :thumbsup:

customer_engineer: They accepted the window. Sending access details in DM. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

leo: I'll grab the support bundle and run initial correlation now — will post back with any quick wins.

oncall-bot: Updated INC-2026-1875 status -> triaged, in-progress.

emily: Thanks team — keep updates to the incident channel and DM me for customer comms drafts.

sara.k: Closing loop later with a short postmortem once we have patch/rollout details.
